GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c|undici.notes: DoS via excessive content-encodings in undici@6.29.0, bundled inside npm@11.21.1 (under node-gyp) under @semantic-release/npm@13.2.0. Release tooling only; it talks to the npm registry and Node.js download servers, never user-supplied URLs. The non-bundled copies are updated to 6.29.1 and 7.30.1. Overrides cannot replace npm's bundled copy. Recheck when npm 11.x ships undici >=6.29.1 or @semantic-release/npm accepts npm 12.

GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx|undici.notes: Agent drops function-valued tls options such as checkServerIdentity in undici@6.29.0, bundled inside npm@11.21.1 (under node-gyp) under @semantic-release/npm@13.2.0. node-gyp passes only CA strings through connect, requestTls and proxyTls and never sets a tls callback, so the bypass is unreachable. The non-bundled copies are updated to 6.29.1 and 7.30.1. Overrides cannot replace npm's bundled copy. Recheck when npm 11.x ships undici >=6.29.1 or @semantic-release/npm accepts npm 12.

GHSA-qrxm-fqhp-jwvm|undici.notes: Process crash on TLS 1.2 renegotiation to a mismatched certificate in undici@6.29.0, bundled inside npm@11.21.1 (under node-gyp) under @semantic-release/npm@13.2.0. Release tooling only; node-gyp downloads Node.js headers from nodejs.org, which semantic-release's publish never triggers, and the worst case is a crashed run on an ephemeral runner. The non-bundled copies are updated to 6.29.1 and 7.30.1. Overrides cannot replace npm's bundled copy. Recheck when npm 11.x ships undici >=6.29.1 or @semantic-release/npm accepts npm 12.
